author: Rania K.
caption: Took the long path down from Bsharri. Three hours, one monastery cut into the cliff, and a man who insisted I take his thermos.

author: Marc H.
caption: The lemonade stand everyone tells you about is real and it is worth the queue.
imageBrief: Glass of cloudy fresh lemonade on a worn wooden counter, Batroun old souk in soft focus behind, warm afternoon

author: Yara S.
caption: Hippodrome at seven in the morning, completely empty. Two thousand years of chariot racing and one stray cat.
imageBrief: Empty Roman hippodrome at Tyre at sunrise, long stone spine receding, one cat on the track, low golden light

author: Elias N.
caption: Sunset from the Corniche. Half the city is out walking and someone is always selling corn.
imageBrief: Beirut Corniche at sunset crowded with walkers, Raouche sea stacks silhouetted in the distance, warm rose sky
